description: Call this when the user asks how much they could save on property taxes if their assessment went down, or whether contesting is worth the fee. Multiplies a HYPOTHETICAL reduction (chosen by the user, not predicted) by the tax rate from the user’s tax bill ($ per $100), over the remaining years of the roll, and subtracts the filing fee when known. Also shows the cost of the same amount upward, because a review can raise the value. Ask the user for their tax rate: Payotte does not guess municipal rates.

annees_restantes.description: Optional: years of the roll the reduction would cover (1-3).

baisse.description: Hypothetical reduction: in CAD (e.g. 30000) or as a fraction (e.g. 0.08 for 8%).

municipalite.description: Quebec municipality (optional but recommended: sets remaining roll years and the fee).

taux.description: Property-tax rate in $ per $100 of assessment, from the user’s tax bill (e.g. 0.75).

name: estimer_economie
title: Économie de taxes d'une baisse d'évaluation / Tax saving of an assessment reduction (Quebec)
